title: Audio Block
description: Add spatial or ambient audio sources with proximity trigger support.

audiourl.description: URL to the audio file (WAV, MP3, OGG formats)

positional.description: Enable (1) positional/spatial audio or (0) ambient audio. Only the literal '1' enables it; anything else is ambient.

loop.description: Loop the audio (1) or play once (0)

autoplay.description: Auto-play on load (1) or wait for trigger (0)

coneinnerangle.description: Inner cone angle for directional audio (degrees)

coneouterangle.description: Outer cone angle for directional audio (degrees)

distancemodel.description: Distance model for volume falloff calculation

triggerlocationx.description: Width of the proximity trigger zone (0 = disabled)

triggerlocationy.description: Height of the proximity trigger zone (0 = disabled)

triggerlocationz.description: Depth of the proximity trigger zone (0 = disabled)

triggerlocationposx.description: X offset of the trigger zone from audio position

triggerlocationposy.description: Y offset of the trigger zone from audio position

triggerlocationposz.description: Z offset of the trigger zone from audio position

isspatial.description: Play a spatial-audio FILE (ambisonic/object-based) described by spatialmetaurl, instead of a plain stereo source.

spatialmetaurl.description: URL of the spatial-audio metadata file used when isspatial is '1'.
